digital.detail: SAP migrated to S/4HANA (reported in FY24 AR); statutory auditor confirms accounting runs on SAP HANA S4 (FY26); additional SAP modules under development (CWIP Rs 224.58 mn).

MRPL claims first refinery to introduce AI-based RTOs in process units; implemented in polypropylene, captive power plant and PFCC; 2 patents filed for algorithms (FY24). PFCC RTO moved from advisory to closed-loop mode.

digital.initiative: REVEAL AI suite (PolyOptima, Power Optima, Rotary Sentinel AI, FLARE REVEAL)
digital.detail: In-house AI suite: PolyOptima soft-sensor/RTO for PP (MFI, xylene solubles; GoI Best Innovation award Sep-2022); Power Optima hybrid digital twins of turbines for steam/power loading; Rotary Sentinel AI multi-agent reliability framework (MoPNG Special Innovation Award Nov-2024); FLARE REVEAL causal-AI flaring root cause; planned Refinery Virtual Assistant. Per MD M. Shyamprasad Kamath (May 2026).

digital.initiative: Agentic AI, RPA and flare analytics
digital.detail: FY26: working on Agentic AI frameworks for equipment reliability; RPA for routine workflows; flare monitoring & analytics implemented.

AI/ML prescriptive maintenance tool for hydroprocessing recycle gas compressor completed FY24; vibration sensors on critical rotating machines; FY26 AR cites real-time monitoring of critical equipment and piping with digital sensors.
FY26: unified enterprise data platform with advanced analytics as single source of truth; groundwork for predictive/prescriptive analytics.

digital.initiative: Digital Procurement Portal & Vendor Invoice Management
digital.detail: FY26: end-to-end e-procurement workflow (PR to PO) with role-based access; vendor invoice management system for digital capture/verification.
ISO/IEC 27001:2022-aligned ISMS upgrade (FY26); 24x7 Security Operations Centre (FY24); DPDP Act compliance under way.
Online stack and ETP analyser data integrated with CPCB portal via IoT for real-time compliance reporting (FY26).
Drones and AI for safety observations, mast-climbing work platform used during shutdown (FY24); FY26 risk register notes SOPs for drone threats / no-fly zone.

news.headline: MRPL signs MoU with ISPRL to use underground caverns for crude storage
news.summary: Lease of ISPRL Mangaluru cavern storage to improve supply security without capex.

news.headline: Tripartite MoU with SOCAR and ONGC at India Energy Week 2025
news.summary: MoU for supply/trade of crude, LNG and products between SOCAR and ONGC group (date = MRPL press-release filing).

news.headline: FY25 results: PAT falls to Rs 51 cr; record 18.044 MMT crude throughput
news.summary: GRM US$4.45/bbl vs 10.36; distillate yield 81.93%; record ATF 2.72 MMT.

news.headline: CRISIL reaffirms AAA/Stable and A1+
news.summary: Cites ONGC support; FY25 EBITDA fell to Rs 2,469 cr; debt Rs 12,867 cr.

news.headline: CareEdge reaffirms CARE AAA; Stable / CARE A1+
news.summary: Notes FY25 GRM moderation, ~33% export revenue, expected debt rise in FY26.

news.headline: Toxic gas leak at MRPL kills two, one hospitalised
news.summary: Two operators found unconscious on tank FB7029A (dry slop) platform in oil movement section; inquiry committee set up. FY26 BRSR reports 2 employee fatalities.

news.headline: Q1 FY26 net loss Rs 272 cr; GRM US$3.88/bbl
news.summary: 45-day Phase-II planned shutdown and inventory losses; throughput 3.52 MMT.

news.headline: Q2 FY26 swing to Rs 639 cr profit; first cargo of Kuwait 'Hout' crude processed
news.summary: EBITDA Rs 1,565 cr; throughput 4.43 MMT; Devangonthi terminal record 65.4 TKL dispatch in Sep-2025.

news.headline: MRPL pauses Russian oil purchases after US sanctions on Rosneft/Lukoil
news.summary: Executive cites difficulty tracing sanctioned entities; MRPL had bought ~3 mn bbl/month of Russian oil.

news.headline: ICRA keeps [ICRA]AAA (Stable)/A1+ on Rs 28,548 cr limits
news.summary: Change-in-limits rationale; issuer rating AAA (Stable).

news.headline: Q3 FY26 PAT Rs 1,445 cr; borrowings cut to Rs 9,290 cr
news.summary: Revenue Rs 29,720 cr; throughput 4.70 MMT; D/E 0.63.

news.headline: MRPL scouts for Venezuelan oil as it halts Russian imports
news.summary: Finance head: strict sanctions compliance, no Russian crude being imported; ~40% crude from Middle East.

news.headline: MRPL wins two FIPI awards at India Energy Week 2026
news.summary: FIPI Innovator of the Year (Team) 2025; Young Achiever (Male) for R. Karthick.

news.headline: Reports that MRPL declared force majeure on March-April gasoline exports amid Gulf war
news.summary: Reuters/traders reported FM as Hormuz shipping halted; MRPL later denied (see 2026-03-05).

news.headline: MRPL shuts a 100,000-bpd CDU and secondary units (incl. hydrocracker) on crude shortage; clarifies no force majeure
news.summary: West Asia conflict disrupted Middle East crude; company told exchanges it had not invoked force majeure.

news.headline: FY26 results: PAT Rs 1,931 cr, GRM US$9.22/bbl; Q4 PAT Rs 119 cr
news.summary: Revenue Rs 1,05,155 cr; EBITDA Rs 6,449 cr; Rs 4/share dividend; 85 new HiQ outlets.

news.headline: ONGC board approves petrochemicals marketing JV of ONGC, MRPL and OPaL (50:25:25)
news.summary: MRPL to invest Rs 12.5 cr; pending DIPAM approval.

news.headline: MRPL MD outlines AI 'REVEAL' suite for smart operations
news.summary: PolyOptima, Power Optima, Rotary Sentinel AI, FLARE REVEAL; closed-loop PFCC optimiser.

news.headline: PNGRB authorises MRPL ATF pipeline from Devangonthi to Bengaluru airport
news.summary: 2.5 MMTPA pipeline to KIA fuel farms, completion within 36 months.

news.headline: Dr. Seema appointed Government nominee director
news.summary: MoPNG board restructuring; D.K. Ojha later left board (10-Jul-2026).

news.headline: MRPL first state refiner to charter Iraqi crude since Hormuz blockade
news.summary: Aframax Jasmin Joy to load Basrah crude 19-20 July.

news.headline: Q1 FY27: consolidated PAT Rs 945.68 cr, revenue Rs 41,609 cr
news.summary: Standalone PAT Rs 915 cr; EBITDA Rs 1,860 cr; throughput 4.43 MMT; includes Rs 471.76 cr exceptional income.

news.headline: FY26 Annual Report filed; 38th AGM set for 24-Aug-2026
news.summary: Net-zero 2038, BRSR assured by Bureau Veritas; green H2 500 TPA by Mar-2027.

news.headline: MRPL crude tender asks suppliers to avoid Red Sea and Strait of Hormuz
news.summary: First Indian refiner to add such routing clause; deliveries 25 Aug-6 Sep.

news.headline: ONGC approves US$500 mn parent guarantee for MRPL's Saudi Aramco crude imports
news.summary: Guarantee valid 1-Sep-2026 to 31-Aug-2028.

news.headline: MRPL wins GEEF Global WaterTech Award 2026
news.summary: Water Efficiency Management Company of the Year.

news.headline: MRPL director: Indian refineries running at 105-108% of capacity
news.summary: Nandakumar Pillai at APPEC: diesel prioritised over jet; MRPL to run >100% until March 2027.
